notes.title: April 6th Patch notes
notes.content:
-Fixed a glitch where on controller, if given a choice in the dialogue, the button wouldn't get focused, and you had to use the mouse. This shouldn't happen anymore.
-Fixed a few typos
-Removed some Health kits where it seemed like there were too many

notes.title: REV5 - Patch notes - April 3rd
notes.content: -Fixed an issue with the Pistol Ammo UI staying on the screen.

notes.title: April 2nd Fixes-REV4- Please update before playing
notes.content:
Patch notes
-Fixed an area in the sewers where you could fall through the map while going through a door
-Fixed a bug where items weren't stacking
-Deleted some enemies as per a review request
-added a melee ready animation when aiming the baseball bat
-Fixed a medkit in the sewers not being grabbable
-re-balanced ammo values

Thanks to whoever has played and helped make the game better.
